item.title: I need a CT scan because I’m sick. (Content warning: mental health, medical discussion)
item.description: I know ppl hate selfies. I’m sorry- I can explain. My reason for sharing- is that I’m historically an artist- and the profession of my disease (EGPA), combined with a neck injury and slow healing, has left me with gnarly, radiating nerve pain. This has greatly impacted my ability to draw, play guitar, play video games… clean my own dishes, or laundry. I feel pathetic and useless and the way my art manifests these days is in the form of makeup and light body painting. I’ve shared my makeup looks here before and have received some really sweet feedback, it means the world. After the makeup pics… and some nonsense…. It gets a little real. There’s a CT scan report from my first time with this recurrent issue. I was inpatient at the hospital, with “opacified” sinuses, with fungal involvement. Thus began my personal hell with my sinuses and lungs at the hands of my disease. I’m posting again- to ask for help- because as this is going on, I am uninsured, awaiting my appeal to be approved (thankfully after that I’m supposed to get reimbursed for my out of pocket costs ) I just got over the hump with the help of some kind imgurians for my rat boys who had mites. I feel embarrassed and ashamed to be in this position. With the gradual decline in my wellbeing, and the one bit of sanity hanging on by the thread that is my rats…. I just have to try, push forward, not give up. I’ve tried to give up on life twice and I cannot do it again. This is a link to my ko fi where u can see and support my art- https://ko-fi.com/darkratlord/goal?g=87 Or my direct PyPal is- @sillygooseinc Again warning there’s some stuff that shows my disease in this post. Skin symptoms, swelling, the reports, etc if that is sensitive for you do not proceed. (I have medical trauma and I get it.) Thank you for anyone who bothered to check in and the buddies I have on here who check on me. I lose hope in a lot of ways…. But this community helps me hold on to hope. Have a good day

item.title: GovBrief Today #541
item.description: A federal appeals court showed up Saturday morning to stop Donald Trump from deciding who gets a mail ballot. His March executive order told Homeland Security to build citizen lists, ordered the Postal Service to refuse mail ballots to any voter not on them, and told prosecutors to charge election officials who sent ballots to the wrong people. The court kept the order blocked through November 3, ruling it would sow confusion and cost voters their ballots, because eligible citizens are missing from the lists. Trump's order is now dead for the midterms in the 23 states and the District of Columbia that sued, and that effectively means the whole country. USPS told the court it cannot run one mail system for those states and another for the rest. I've emailed 8,384 stories over 541 straight nights, free and without ads. item.title: Not fake, just "averaged"
item.description:
If you see SUPER sharp astronomy images, they have likely been stacked. This is a method perfected for astrophotography. It takes hundreds or thousands of still images and digitally averages them together. Here's how I do it: I attach my smartphone to my telescope and start recording video while the planet gently floats across the view. At 60fps, I can easily record 600 to 1000 frames during one "flyby". This creates an MP4 video file where each frame varies in quality due to the turbulence of the atmosphere. Shown above on the left is a not-so-good frame. Then I run it through a free software app called PIPP which takes each video frame and slices it into an individual photo. Then it crops the photo so that the planet is dead center in each photo. Lastly, I run another free program called AutoStakkert that takes all those images and allows me to use the very best (400 in this case) to be averaged into one sharp image, shown on the right. These software packages work on other objects too, such as the international space station, so it doesn't have to be round. It's truly an example of the "Enhance!" joke we see on so many TV shows, but it really works in this case. It seems like magic to me.
In 2024 one of the eclipse glasses I bought was defective. If you're one of the lucky folks to see the upcoming solar eclipse in Spain, please check if your eclipse glasses are good or not. Three non-technical ways to check at home: https://youtu.be/Q8aYrD32aAM
